core.purpose: Reusable deterministic contracts, models, repair behavior and orchestration.

analysis.purpose: External format translation and read-only semantic derivation.

policy-data.purpose: Versioned Minecraft platform facts, executable capability rules, and persisted structural schemas.

quality.purpose: Regression evidence, coverage, update intelligence and reproducible fixtures.

runtime-proof.purpose: Bounded Minecraft runtime proof harnesses and controlled laboratories.

engineering-governance.purpose: Engineering and validation contracts that constrain implementation without defining map design.

design-system.purpose: Game Design schema, vocabulary, templates, and deterministic compilation support. Actual map design remains project-local.
